description: It’s always a feel-good moment to pack that bag with soup, chili and peanut butter, knowing that the food I supply will help sustain my neighbors. But this week’s pickup is special: Saturday, June 13, is the hundredth neighborhood pickup — a milestone for a program that has collected more than 2.3 million pounds of food to supply Ashland Emergency Food Bank.
title: Viewpoint: A landmark week for Ashland Food Project - REPRESENTATIVE PAM MARSH
